title: Robustness of V2 and V3
question: Do the narrow V2/V3 passes survive placebo, subgroup and head-to-head checks?
headline: V2 direction holds: placebo assets 50.5% (≈ 50% as it should be), related assets without crypto-price markets 53.4%. V3: skilled minus other wallets' flow = -3.40 points per market (CI -5.99 to -1.32), so skilled wallets do not move first beyond ordinary order-flow momentum.
notes: Added after V2 and V3 passed narrowly; reported as a robustness check, not a new pass rule.
Verdict reflects V2 only; the wallet head-to-head is reported in the metrics and headline.
